messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 triggered for svc-inference — us-east-1 error rate spike (5xx) over 4% for 3min, paging @maria and SRE rota. dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/svc-inference/errors :rotating_light:

maria: I'm oncall, looking at traces. Latency up, queue depth up on n1-gpu-pool-3. Initial hypothesis: noisy tenant causing backpressure + upstream provider congestion.

ashok: hey, can you confirm if it's single provider or AZ?

maria: seems concentrated in us-east-1 on provider:acme-cloud-us-east (node set a2-*). 95th latency doubled, tails at 2.1s.

devon: copying — i'm near a terminal. recommend immediate traffic shaping + partial drain of noisy pool. Also set token-level rate caps for free-tier to reduce noise.

lee: +1 to rate caps. Which routes do we apply? suggestions: gen/text and chat/stream.

maria: start with global soft caps on chat/stream in us-east-1, 60rps per-tenant burst 120, also start graceful drain 30% of a2 nodes to eu-west-1 as fallback.

ops-bot: (action) start-runbook: evasive-traffic-mitigation v3.1 — initiated by maria at 2113579025

devon: I'll run change. command below — will apply caps and start provider reroute for 30% traffic.

devon: ```
redwoodctl quota update --region us-east-1 --route \"chat/*\" --max-rps 60 --burst 120 --scope tenant:free
redwoodctl drain --region us-east-1 --pool a2-gpu-pool-3 --percent 30 --strategy graceful --reason \"noisy tenant + provider congestion\"
redwoodctl reroute --from us-east-1 --to eu-west-1 --percent 30 --provider gcp --mode progressive
```

maria: executing now. will monitor ; leaving logs here.

maria: applied rate caps at 2113579055, initiating drain & reroute.

ashok: i'm watching ingress — do we want to enable per-route fallback to smaller quantized model for heavy requests? that reduces GPU pressure.

devon: yes, toggling embed/quantized-fallback on non-enterprise customers. command: ```redwoodctl toggle-feature --feature quant-fallback --scope non-enterprise --region us-east-1 on```

lee: also recommend disabling non-critical async features (telemetry forwarding for free tier) to reduce egress.

maria: customer-impact note: CS reported ~22 tenants saw elevated 5xx in last 10m; top impacted customers: team-alpha (ingest heavy), shoplight (embed api). CS is being looped in.

customer-success-jess: I'm on it — notifying affected accounts with templated message. ETA for initial outreach 10m. Will include mitigation steps and expected timeline.

devon: after caps/reroute, error rate dropped from 4.3% -> 1.2% in 2m. latency 95th trending down. continuing reroute to 50% if stable.

maria: good. let's not do full evacuation yet. next step: if error rate <1.5% for 5m, continue incremental reroute to 50% and hold. if oscillation, rollback reroute for 10m.

ops-bot: (metric) error_rate(svc-inference,us-east-1)=1.1% at 2113579158.

ashok: can we also incrementally raise Dedicated tenant quotas to prevent collateral impact? some committed customers hitting caps now.

maria: yes — exempt list: enterprise-*, partner-*; we'll add exceptions for committed tenants. devon, can you patch exception policy?

devon: done at 2113579189: updated policy, added enterprise- and partner- prefixes to cap-exempt list. verified via policy list.

lee: small ask: please keep raw command outputs pinned here — helps postmortem.

devon: pasted logs: ```
[2113579055] quota:update OK
[2113579060] drain:start pool=a2-gpu-pool-3 percent=30 strategy=graceful
[2113579078] reroute:init from=us-east-1 to=eu-west-1 percent=30 provider=gcp
[2113579189] policy:update cap-exempt enterprise,partner
```

maria: handing oncall to ashok at 2113579200 — ashok you'll own for escalation & postmortem. @ashok please ack.

ashok: ack, i'm on. i'll consolidate timeline and runbook notes.

incident-bot: Reminder: create incident channel and set severity to Sev1 if customer impact > 10 tenants.

maria: channel created: #inc-2113579012-manhattan-evac. severity set to Sev1 at 2113579220.

customer-success-jess: initial outreach sent at 2113579250 to 22 affected tenants. few replies: two reported transient 502s, both recovered post-reroute. I'm flagging team-alpha for follow-up.

devon: metrics stable for 4m, starting to increase reroute to 50% at 2113579300.

ops-bot: (action) dynamic-batching tuned down for us-east-1 to favor latency at 2113579320.

maria: final note for now — we've avoided full failover; mitigation sequence was: apply soft rate caps -> partial drain 30% -> progressive provider reroute -> enable quant-fallback + disable non-critical features -> policy exemptions for enterprise. Customer impact reduced, continuing to monitor.

ashok: I'll own postmortem and coordinate with product for compensations if needed. tagging @customer-success-jess for formal impact report.

customer-success-jess: will prepare impact report and share draft in #inc-2113579012-manhattan-evac within 2hrs.

lee: thanks all. leaving logs + links to dashboards in channel. calling it stable for now but oncall remains until handoff window. :white_check_mark:

maria: handing back to rotation at 2113579400 — followups to be tracked in incident channel.

ops-bot: (close-runbook) evasive-traffic-mitigation v3.1 — actions completed, runbook closed at 2113579412
